why: `gadget()` in `use.m` calls the file's local function `gadget`, which comes before a class constructor in an `@` folder (MATLAB doc 'Function Precedence Order': local functions before class constructors), so `g` is a struct and `tidy(g)` calls the path's `tidy.m`, not `@gadget/tidy.m` (the step 15 review's probe).
